hardware.note: Public TC peaks marked with sparsity were divided by two. PCIe is a nominal one-direction ceiling, not measured application throughput.

distance_caveat: 16-bit buffers require explicit overflow/undefined encodings; they are not a universal bound on distance. DTM and DTZ50 need distinct correct algorithms.

resident_operator_rooflines.name: naive material-specific FP16 relation + expanded output
resident_operator_rooflines.caveat: Resident operator only; mask generation, layout changes, rank/gathers, packing instructions, spill traffic, global convergence and other pieces are excluded. Static shared matrix assumed hot in cache. FP8 peak is optimistic; full-precision accumulation can reduce attainable arithmetic throughput.

tensor_packing_scalar_sensitivity.caveat: Not measured SASS. Unpack/select/reduce/repack, 64-bit lowering and register occupancy can dominate. Compare warp ballot packing with tile reductions on hardware. A packed stencil amortizes many operations over 64 source rows.

generation_export_bounds.note: Keep the fixed point on the GPU. Do not transfer the full state every round. Final compression can overlap output, but its throughput must be measured.

through_six_piece_collection.caveat: Listed directory sizes, not downloaded/generated whole collection. Whole-month constant storage assumed; catalogs, writes, requests and API compute additional. Prices depend on remaining account allowances.

conclusion: Packed local stencils and packed-input INT8 tensor kernels share a memory roof. The latter only accelerates eligible operators. No complete end-to-end runtime follows from TOPS alone.
